method: Read all 49 ui.chat.sidebar values at the current head against the English source and the en context sidecar; key sets equal, no English stub. Parsed all 49 messages with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser. Intended es deltas only: the many arms on groups.badge, catalogue.total_search and catalogue.total_search_clipped, and groups.badge's explicit {badge, number, ::group-off} per arm instead of #, the documented way to keep the compact badge ungrouped. No ICU or render error.

Checked glossary and register: 'agentes integrados' matches agents.dismiss_offer and ui.agents.starters; 'chat/chats' is the audited es house loanword; builtin_offer addresses the reader as tú; sentence case, spaced em dash, no '!'.

findings.reason: The denominator is a bare number followed by a fixed noun, so at an exact multiple of 10^6 it reads 'de 1000000 chats'. Spanish requires the 'de' complement for the numeral noun millon at exact millions: RAE DPD, cardinales, states '1 000 000 de personas' but '1 200 000 personas' for a complex numeral. The locale already carries this exact total-plural shape in ui.mesh.mesh_node.shown_conversations and ui.schedules.count.list_truncated, both with a many arm and 'de conversaciones'. The numerator's many arm is correct; only the denominator lacks the category. Minor: no count is lost and the value is an edge of the census domain, not a normal catalogue size.
findings.evidence: IntlMessageFormat es, current: total=1000000 -> 'Mostrando 1 de 1000000 chats'; total=1500000 -> 'Mostrando 1 de 1500000 chats'. Proposed: total=1000000 -> 'Mostrando 1 de 1000000 de chats'; total=1500000 -> 'Mostrando 1 de 1500000 chats'. Same behaviour for total_search and total_search_clipped; the shown many arm already yields '1000000 de coincidencias'.

findings.reason: Spanish CLDR selects many at exact multiples of 10^6, and this message has no many arm, so ICU falls back to other and 1,000,000 renders '1000000 agentes integrados' instead of '1000000 de agentes integrados'. The sibling ui.agents.starters.available, counting the same packaged built-ins, already carries 'de agentes integrados'; ui.mesh.mesh_list.conversation_count shows the explicit =0 plus many pattern. The packaged profile count is single-digit today, so this arm cannot occur with today's shipped profile set; recorded for CLDR completeness, not as a user-facing defect.
